articles.title: Incheon stabbing suspect tests negative for psychopathy

The Incheon Metropolitan Police Agency conducted a psychopathy test on the 59-year-old suspect, Choi Choong-rak, but his score fell below the 25 out of 40 points needed to classify him as a psychopath. The rampage left eight people injured, including one who remains unconscious after suffering cardiac arrest.

articles.title: You Can See Everything Is Unexpectedly Heartbreaking
articles.dek: In an unexpectedly wrenching scene in You Can See Everything , Elizabeth Holmes is posing under bright lights, a series of dots penned on her face. Her hair is scraped back and tucked under a bald cap, and a photographer instructs her to close her eyes and open her mouth, then open her eyes and close her mouth, and so on. The idea is to map each part of her face and body so that when she reports to federal prison the next month, she will leave behind a hologram of herself—an avatar to talk to her fiancé Billy Evans and their two very young children (a toddler and a newborn) while she is away.
